operationHelp.trim_whitespace: Removes spaces at the start and end of each value.
operationHelp.collapse_whitespace: Replaces runs of spaces with a single space.
operationHelp.remove_control_characters: Removes control and invisible characters (e.g. zero-width spaces). Tabs and line breaks become spaces.
operationHelp.standardize_case: Makes text lower case, UPPER CASE or Title Case.
operationHelp.normalize_dates: Rewrites dates as YYYY-MM-DD. Ambiguous dates (e.g. 01/02/2024) are left unchanged unless you state the day order.
operationHelp.convert_type: Converts to integer, decimal or true/false. Values that can't be converted are reported and kept (or emptied if you choose).
operationHelp.map_values: Replaces values from your list, one pair per line: from = to. Values not in the list are unchanged.
operationHelp.remove_duplicate_rows: Removes rows that are identical in the chosen columns. Rows that merely look alike are never removed, only reported.
operationHelp.fill_missing: Fills empty cells with a value, mean, median or most common value - or removes the row.

skipReason.not a number - excluded from the calcula: not a number, excluded from the calculation

datasets.cleaningIntro: Operations run in order on a copy. Preview first - the result is saved as a new version and the original is never changed.
datasets.previewOutdated: The operations changed - preview again before applying.
datasets.previewPotentialDuplicates: {{count}} possible duplicates (differ only in case/spacing) - not removed
datasets.previewScoreNote: The score is calculated on the remaining rows. Removing rows can raise the score without the remaining data being any better.
datasets.confirmRemovalMessage: {{count}} rows are removed in the new version. The original version is kept and can be restored. Continue?
datasets.restoreConfirm: Create a new version that is an exact copy of v{{version}}? Nothing is overwritten.

dataQuality.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this rule?
dataQuality.noMonitoringData: Once quality rules are created for each dimension, monitoring data will appear here.
dataQuality.noDataset: None (the rule is not tied to a dataset)
dataQuality.monitoringEmptyUpload: Upload a dataset and scan it. Checks, issues and health per dimension then appear here.
dataQuality.monitoringEmptyScan: Scan one of your datasets to run the quality checks. The results then appear here.
dataQuality.rulesIntro: Rules with an executable type are checked against the latest version of their dataset - on every scan or when you press Run. Other rules are documentation only.

ruleTypeHelp.not_null: A row fails when the cell is empty.
ruleTypeHelp.unique: Rows fail when the same value appears more than once. Empty cells are not judged.
ruleTypeHelp.email_format: A row fails when the value is not a valid e-mail address. Empty cells are not judged.
ruleTypeHelp.numeric_range: A row fails when the value is not a number or is outside the range.
ruleTypeHelp.allowed_values: A row fails when the value is not in the list.
ruleTypeHelp.date_range: A row fails when the value is not an unambiguous date or is outside the range.
ruleTypeHelp.other: Stored as a description. The rule is not run and does not affect the quality score.

dataQuality.customTypePlaceholder: Describe the rule type, e.g. manual review
dataQuality.executableNeedsTarget: An executable rule needs a dataset and a column.
dataQuality.definitionOnlyHelp: This rule type is not executed by the platform.
